name: publicWeb_getMyKennels
description: The app's Kennels tab for a signed-in web member (E9.F7.S9): every live, eligible kennel (KennelStatus NOT IN (-1, 4) — the app's rule — or any kennel the member has runs at or calls home) with the member's own live HasherKennelMap row alongside where one exists, and everything the app's kennel card and kennel page draw from the synced tables: following / home / member state, notification and email preferences, run and haring counts, last run date, credit, the location line as the app composes it, the city's coordinates for 'N km from here', the kennel's last and next run, default prices, and a lower-case search text for the app's search. ORDER BY KennelName; the client re-sorts. HasherPreferences (v3, 2026-09-27) carries the caller's own unit / radius bitfield. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 112, @param NULL); scoped to the token's user. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 112). No SQL default.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success, before the data rowsets: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: Kennels
rowsets.description: On success: one row per eligible live kennel (deleted = 0, removed = 0), ORDER BY KennelName. Member-specific columns are 0 / NULL where the caller has no live HasherKennelMap row (HasHkm = 0).

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The app's location line (query_kennels.dart): 'City, [Region, ]Country' — region only when Country.ShowRegion = 1; just the country (or '') when there is no city.

columns.name: CityLat
columns.description: City.Latitude — for 'N km from here' and the kennel map.

columns.name: HasHkm
columns.description: 1 when the caller has a live HasherKennelMap row for the kennel.

columns.name: IsMember
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.IsMember — legacy flag. Membership is MembershipExpirationDate in the future, not this (see codeSmells).

columns.name: MembershipExpirationDate
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.MembershipExpirationDate — the member test (in the future = member).

columns.name: KennelMismanagementTeam
columns.description: CR-separated rows, tab between role and name

columns.name: KennelCredit
columns.description: COALESCE(HasherKennelMap.KennelCredit, 0) — the caller's credit at the kennel.

columns.name: HasherPreferences
columns.description: Since 1.1.0 (2026-09-27): the caller's HC.Hasher.Preferences (COALESCE 0). 0x03 distance unit (3 = miles, 1/2 = km, 0 = Auto), 0x3C >> 2 radius ladder. Same on every row.

columns.name: LastRunGmt
columns.description: EventStartDatetimeGmt of the kennel's latest visible live run before now.

columns.name: LastRunLocal
columns.description: That run's CAST(EventStartDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — wall clock.

columns.name: NextRunGmt
columns.description: EventStartDatetimeGmt of the kennel's next visible live run at or after now.

columns.name: SearchText
columns.description: The app's searchKennelsText, lower-cased: ' ' + names, slug, city, region, country and the four *SearchTags (commas → spaces).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (lines 24-25). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

Line 76 returns HasherKennelMap.IsMember. Membership is decided by MembershipExpirationDate in the future and nothing else (James, 2026-10-02); a client that reads IsMember will disagree with the app for lapsed or newly paid members. MembershipExpirationDate is returned too — the web should test that, and IsMember should not be relied on.

Lines 112-117 concatenate non-MAX NVARCHARs whose declared widths sum past 4000 (four NVARCHAR(4000) tag columns), so the result is typed NVARCHAR(4000) and anything beyond is cut without error. Tags are short today.

codeSmells.issue: Two OUTER APPLY lookups per kennel
codeSmells.detail: Lines 126-139 run a TOP 1 next-run and last-run seek for every eligible kennel (thousands) on every call. Acceptable with the EventStartDateTimeGmt index, but it is the cost centre if this page slows down.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
